[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sandwiches and Burgers: Au Cheval, Xoco, Mr. Beef.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other Local Favorites: Girl & the Goat, Black Dog Gelato, Pequod's Pizza.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Food Halls and Markets: Eataly, Revival Food Hall, Chicago French Market.
